title: Add a superseded-wording sweep to the hardening checklist for ADR amendments
body: Outcome: docs/program/hardening-checklist.md gains a class for decision amendments: when a decision narrows or replaces a gate, every sentence in the amended ADRs that still states the old gate is updated in the same PR (PR #217 review attempt 1 FAIL: ADR 0002 Deferred still deferred schema and index after D32). Proof: the checklist rules test asserts the class and krn brief check refuses a brief that leaves it unanswered.
